headline: Why TransDigm (TDG) Stock Is Trading Up Today
summary: Shares of aerospace and defense company TransDigm (NYSE:TDG) jumped 4.1% in the afternoon session after the company announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Prince & Izant for approximately $1.066 billion in cash. summary: Prince & Izant deal puts TransDigm Group in focus TransDigm Group (TDG) has drawn fresh investor attention after agreeing to acquire Prince & Izant for about $1.07b in cash, a move that coincided with the stock gaining 4.1%. See our latest analysis for TransDigm Group.
